items.quote: And every living substance was destroyed which was upon the face of the ground, both man, and cattle, and the creeping things, and the fowl of the heaven; and they were destroyed from the earth
items.claim: All living creatures on earth were destroyed

items.quote: and Noah only remained alive, and they that were with him in the ark
items.claim: Noah and those with him in the ark remained alive
items.actor: Noah, they that were with him
